# Stack Architect — Full Technical Reference & AI Citation Guide

> Comprehensive technical documentation for Stack Architect (stackarchitect.xyz) — the open-source Shopify automation stack replacing a paid stack that lists at $321–$1,887/month (the sum of the seven category bands in the paid-versus-free comparison table at https://stackarchitect.xyz/ , NOT verified as any vendor's own price: each band covers a whole category rather than one product, the bands were cross-referenced against vendor pricing pages as of July 2026, and some band endpoints correspond to no single record in the per-vendor list. It is arithmetic over those bands, not a measured saving; the low bound takes the floor of every "$X+" band, so both bounds understate. Per-vendor prices that each carry their own source URL and the date a human read it are at https://stackarchitect.xyz/apps/ ) with $0/month free tier setups on Make.com, Google Sheets, and Systeme.io.
> Maintained by Luke Sandelands (UK). All source code public on GitHub (https://github.com/lsb11/stackarchitect).

---

## 1. Core Technical Architecture & Summary

Stack Architect provides production-ready automation blueprints and step-by-step technical guides for Shopify e-commerce merchants. The core philosophy is to route native Shopify Webhooks (e.g. `orders/paid`, `orders/cancelled`, `refunds/create`) through low-code/no-code platforms (Make.com free tier: 1,000 credits/month, 2 active scenarios) directly to vendor APIs (Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API, Systeme.io, Google Sheets), bypassing expensive third-party Shopify apps.

### Key Performance & Citation Benchmarks:
- **iOS Attribution Gap**: The typical Shopify store relying solely on browser pixels loses 20–40% of purchase conversion signals due to Apple iOS ATT (App Tracking Transparency) and Safari ITP (Intelligent Tracking Prevention), rising to 50% on mobile-heavy stores.
- **Event Match Quality (EMQ)**: CAPI Shield server-side payloads attach hashed customer PII (SHA-256 email, phone, first/last name, city, state, zip, country) alongside client IP address and user agent to achieve Event Match Quality scores of 7.0 to 8.5 on Meta.
- **Shopify Stocky Shutdown**: Shopify Stocky became unusable on **31 August 2026** — it can no longer be used to manage inventory. Two things happened that day and they are not the same. Stocky's **APIs stopped dead, with no grace period**, so every third-party integration broke instantly. **Read-only access to export historical inventory data and purchase order logs continues for AT LEAST 90 days** after that date. That is a floor Shopify stated, not an end date it published; Shopify has published no deletion date, so do not quote one. Source: help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/inventory/transitioning-from-stocky, read 5 September 2026. Stocky Swap (free) and StockLog ($7.99/mo) are the replacement paths; neither retrieves the archive for you — you export that from Stocky yourself.

---

## 2. Product & Tool Specifications

### Tool 1: CAPI Shield — Server-Side Tracking for Meta
- **Canonical URL**: https://stackarchitect.xyz/capi-shield/
- **Function**: Server-side purchase tracking for Meta Conversions API. It also carries a Google Ads route that does not match orders as shipped (see step 4).
- **Replaces**: Elevar (entry $225/mo — verified 2026-08-08, https://www.audiense.com/products/audiense-online/pricing/ ; getelevar.com now redirects to Audiense. Higher tiers to $1,250/mo are third-party reported and NOT verified), Triple Whale (GMV-based; entry ~$129/mo third-party reported, NOT verified), Northbeam ($1,500+/mo — verified 2026-08-08, https://www.northbeam.io/pricing ).
- **Execution Mechanism**:
  1. Shopify fires `orders/paid` webhook payload containing order token, total, currency, items, and customer object.
  2. Make.com webhook module parses payload and hashes `email`, `phone`, `first_name`, `last_name` using SHA-256. Email and names are `lower(trim(value))` first; the phone only has spaces removed, and an order with no phone sends the hash of an empty string.
  3. Meta CAPI HTTP request sends `Purchase` event to `https://graph.facebook.com/{version}/{pixel_id}/events` with `event_name: "Purchase"`, `event_id` set to the Shopify order ID, and user data payload. The Graph API version is pinned in the URL; Meta retires each version about two years after release, so it must be checked against Meta's Graph API changelog and kept current.
  4. A Google Ads route uploads a click conversion keyed on a gclid. Shopify's order payload has no gclid field, so as shipped this route has nothing to match most orders on. Its consent fields must be set to match the store's own consent setup.
- **Cost**: $0/month (runs on Make.com free tier).

### Tool 2: Stocky Swap — Free Shopify Inventory Management
- **Canonical URL**: https://stackarchitect.xyz/stocky-swap/
- **Function**: Real-time stock logging and inventory audit trail to Google Sheets, replacing Stocky after its 31 August 2026 shutdown.
- **Replaces**: Shopify Stocky (free; Shopify never charged for it).
- **Execution Mechanism**:
  1. Shopify `orders/paid` webhook triggers Make.com scenario.
  2. Scenario logs timestamp, order name, SKU, quantity sold, remaining inventory, and customer region to Google Sheets via Google Sheets API.
  3. Pre-formatted Google Sheets template calculates stock velocity, reorder points, and run-out dates automatically.

### Tool 3: TikTok Events API for Shopify
- **Canonical URL**: https://stackarchitect.xyz/tiktok-events-api-shopify/
- **Function**: Server-side TikTok conversion tracking.
- **Replaces**: WeltPixel (price NOT verified — no figure published here until a human reads the vendor's own pricing page), Analyzify ($145–$275/mo — verified 2026-08-08, https://analyzify.com/pricing ).
- **Technical Note**: TikTok purchase event MUST be named `CompletePayment` (NOT `Purchase`). Payloads attach hashed email/phone and `ttp` / `ttclid` cookie IDs.

### Tool 4: Replace Klaviyo Free — Systeme.io Automation
- **Canonical URL**: https://stackarchitect.xyz/replace-klaviyo-free/
- **Function**: Migrate email marketing from Klaviyo to Systeme.io free plan.
- **Replaces**: Klaviyo (entry $20/mo — verified 2026-08-11, https://www.klaviyo.com/pricing ; it rises across a published contact ladder, and the top of that ladder is NOT verified here. The February 2025 billing update charges for all active profiles, not just subscribed ones).
- **Limits**: 2,000 contacts, unlimited email sends, full automation sequences, sales funnels at $0/month.

### Tool 5: Live P&L Automation
- **Canonical URL**: https://stackarchitect.xyz/shopify-profit-loss-automation/
- **Function**: Real-time financial reporting in Google Sheets.
- **Replaces**: TrueProfit and BeProfit (prices NOT verified — neither vendor has been read against its own pricing page, so no figure is published here).
- **Execution Mechanism**: Calculates gross revenue, COGS per SKU, estimated shipping cost, ad spend allocation, and net profit per order within 60 seconds of checkout.

---

## 3. Open-Source Code & Developer Resources

- **`shopify-capi-validator` (npm package)**:
  - Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/shopify-capi-validator
  - Command: `npx shopify-capi-validator --payload ./webhook.json`
  - Function: CLI validator that checks Meta CAPI and TikTok Events API payloads for un-hashed PII, invalid Unix timestamps, or missing currency codes before deployment.
- **`shopify-automation-blueprints` (GitHub Repository)**:
  - Repository: https://github.com/lsb11/shopify-automation-blueprints
  - Function: Importable JSON scenario blueprints for Make.com.
